TCR_CITY.desc: Kerala's cultural capital in one easy day: Vadakkunnathan on its hill, the two Pooram temples, the Kochi king's palace, India's tallest church and the new Puthur zoo.
TCR_CITY.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Thrissur railway station · Thrissur KSRTC bus station · Swaraj Round
8:30 AM — Vadakkunnathan temple: The great Shiva temple in the Thekkinkadu ground at the heart of the Round — home of Thrissur Pooram. (Hindus only inside · dress code)
9:45 AM — Paramekkavu & Thiruvambady: The two rival temples of the Pooram, a short walk apart. (Dress code)
10:45 AM — Shakthan Thampuran Palace: The Kochi king's Kerala-Dutch palace: bronzes, sculptures, old scripts and a serpent grove. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
12:15 PM — Our Lady of Dolours Basilica: India's tallest church and its Bible Tower. Lunch in town after, own expense. (Modest dress)
2:30 PM — Puthur Zoological Park: Kerala's new open-design zoo in the Puthur hills, with large natural enclosures. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Thrissur station, KSRTC bus station, Swaraj Round, or your own stop in the city
TCR_CITY.gtk:
🗓️ Closing days: Shakthan Thampuran Palace and Puthur Zoological Park are closed on Mondays. On Mondays we swap in Vilangan Kunnu hill and more time in town — same price.
👗 Temples & church: Vadakkunnathan admits Hindus only. Men: mundu, shirt off inside; women: saree or churidar. Others can walk the Thekkinkadu ground. Modest dress at the Basilica; no phones or bags inside the temples.
🚶 Walking: The temples around the Round are best on foot — about 2–3 km in all. The zoo is large: allow 2 hours and wear comfortable shoes.
🎉 Pooram & festivals: During Thrissur Pooram (April–May) the Round is packed and roads close — we run a shorter plan. Temple timings change on festival days; we confirm the evening before.
TCR_CITY.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
TCR_CITY.exc: Lunch; Palace, zoo and tower entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
TCR_CITY.carry: Mundu / saree / churidar; Comfortable walking shoes; Hat and water bottle; Cash for entry fees

TCR_ATHIRAPPILLY.desc: Kerala's mightiest waterfalls in a day: the Thumboormuzhi butterfly garden, thundering Athirappilly, roadside Charpa and the forest rapids of Vazhachal on the Chalakudy river.
TCR_ATHIRAPPILLY.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Thrissur railway station · Thrissur KSRTC bus station · Swaraj Round
9:30 AM — Thumboormuzhi dam & butterfly garden: A riverside garden by the old weir, with a hanging bridge. (Entry own expense)
10:30 AM — Athirappilly Falls: The top viewpoint, then the path to the base if open. Lunch nearby, own expense. (Entry own expense)
1:45 PM — Charpa Falls: A cascade right beside the forest road. (Flows in the monsoon)
2:00 PM — Vazhachal Falls: Wide rapids over black rock at the forest's edge. (Viewing area only)
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Thrissur station, KSRTC bus station, Swaraj Round, or your own stop in the city
TCR_ATHIRAPPILLY.gtk:
🌧️ Rain & closures: The forest department closes the falls, or the path to the base, in heavy rain or high water. If a stop is shut, we spend longer at the others — we check the evening before.
🚯 Plastic-free forest: Disposable plastic is not allowed in the forest area; bags may be checked at the entry. Bring a reusable bottle; snacks in boxes, not plastic covers.
🐒 Monkeys & wildlife: Monkeys at the falls snatch food and bags — keep snacks out of sight. Elephants sometimes cross the forest road; everyone stays inside if we stop.
🥾 The walk down: The path to the base of Athirappilly is steep, with many uneven steps — the climb back is slow. Wear shoes with grip; skip it if you have knee or heart trouble.
TCR_ATHIRAPPILLY.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
TCR_ATHIRAPPILLY.exc: Lunch; Falls and garden entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
TCR_ATHIRAPPILLY.carry: Shoes with good grip; Raincoat or umbrella; Reusable water bottle; Cash for entry tickets

TCR_GURUVAYUR.desc: An early start for darshan at Guruvayur's Sri Krishna temple and Mammiyoor, the Punnathur Kotta elephants, the ancient Palayur church and an afternoon on Chavakkad beach.
TCR_GURUVAYUR.itin:
6:00 AM — Pickup: Thrissur railway station · Thrissur KSRTC bus station · Swaraj Round
6:45 AM — Guruvayur Sri Krishna temple: Darshan at 'the Dwarka of the South'; phones and bags to the counters. (Hindus only · strict dress code)
10:45 AM — Mammiyoor temple & lunch: The Shiva temple next door, then lunch, own expense. (Dress code)
12:45 PM — Punnathur Kotta: The temple's elephant yard in an old palace compound. (Entry own expense)
2:15 PM — Palayur church: One of India's oldest churches, believed founded by St Thomas the Apostle. (Modest dress)
3:15 PM — Chavakkad beach: A wide, quiet beach with fishing boats — sea breeze before the drive home. (Walk only · no swimming)
5:30 PM — Drop-off: Thrissur station, KSRTC bus station, Swaraj Round, or your own stop in the city
TCR_GURUVAYUR.gtk:
👗 Dress code: Men: mundu, no shirt (a shawl is fine). Women: saree, churidar or long skirt. No jeans, shorts or T-shirts. Mundus and sarees are sold near the temple if needed.
📵 At the temple: Phones, cameras, bags and footwear are not allowed inside — use the paid counters. Queues of 2–4 hours on weekends, Ekadasi and wedding days; keep water and medicines handy.
🙏 Non-Hindu guests: The two temples admit Hindus only. You can see the East Nada from outside, walk the temple town and join us at the elephant yard. Palayur church and the beach are open to everyone.
🌊 Beach & elephants: Chavakkad beach is for walking only — strong currents, no swimming. At Punnathur Kotta stay behind the barriers; no feeding or touching the elephants.
TCR_GURUVAYUR.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
TCR_GURUVAYUR.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Offerings, special darshan & elephant-yard entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
TCR_GURUVAYUR.carry: Mundu / saree / churidar; Small pouch for medicines; Water bottle; Cash for counters

TCR_MUZIRIS.desc: Two thousand years of Kerala's spice port in a day: Kodungallur's ancient temple, India's oldest mosque, St Thomas's landing place, a Portuguese fort and the Paliam palace.
TCR_MUZIRIS.itin:
8:00 AM — Pickup: Thrissur railway station · Thrissur KSRTC bus station · Swaraj Round
9:15 AM — Kodungallur Bhagavathy temple: The ancient Kurumba Bhagavathy temple of the Bharani festival. (Hindus only inside · dress code)
10:15 AM — Cheraman Juma Masjid: Believed to be India's oldest mosque, restored in old Kerala style. (Modest dress · head cover for women)
11:30 AM — Azhikode Marthoma shrine: Where St Thomas is believed to have landed in AD 52. Lunch nearby, own expense. (Modest dress)
1:45 PM — Kottappuram fort: Ruins of the 1523 Portuguese fort on the Periyar bank. (Open ruins · uneven ground)
2:45 PM — Paliam palace & Nalukettu: Home of Kochi's hereditary prime ministers, now two museums. (Check timings · entry own expense)
5:45 PM — Drop-off: Thrissur station, KSRTC bus station, Swaraj Round, or your own stop in the city
TCR_MUZIRIS.gtk:
🗓️ Timings & days: The Paliam museums open about 10 AM–5 PM; Muziris sites can close on some weekdays — we check the evening before. During Kodungallur Bharani (March–April) the town is packed and we change the plan.
👗 What to wear: Shoulders and knees covered everywhere; women cover their heads at the mosque. The Kodungallur temple admits Hindus only inside — others wait at the gate area.
🚶 Walking: Short walks at each stop; Kottappuram fort is an open site with uneven ground. The palaces are old buildings with steps and low doorways — take it slowly.
🌍 Many faiths, one coast: Temple, mosque and church in one morning — please be quiet at prayer times. Friday midday prayers: we visit the mosque earlier or later that day.
TCR_MUZIRIS.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
TCR_MUZIRIS.exc: Lunch; Museum entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
TCR_MUZIRIS.carry: Clothes covering shoulders and knees; Scarf or shawl; Hat and water bottle; Cash for entry fees

TCR_KALAMANDALAM.desc: A morning inside Kerala Kalamandalam, watching Kathakali and Mohiniyattam classes in session, lunch by the river Nila at Cheruthuruthy, and a lakeside evening at Vazhani dam.
TCR_KALAMANDALAM.itin:
7:45 AM — Pickup: Thrissur railway station · Thrissur KSRTC bus station · Swaraj Round
9:30 AM — Kerala Kalamandalam guided tour: Live classes in the kalaris, the carved Koothambalam theatre, the art gallery and the poet Vallathol's old campus on the river. (Working days only · entry own expense)
1:15 PM — Lunch at Cheruthuruthy: Kerala lunch in the village, own expense.
2:15 PM — Bharathapuzha riverside: A short walk on the banks of the Nila, Kerala's river of poets. (Water level permitting)
3:15 PM — Vazhani dam & garden: Gardens, a hanging bridge and the reservoir below the Machad hills. (Entry own expense)
6:00 PM — Drop-off: Thrissur station, KSRTC bus station, Swaraj Round, or your own stop in the city
TCR_KALAMANDALAM.gtk:
🗓️ Tour days: Kalamandalam tours run 9:30 AM–1 PM on working days only — no Sundays or holidays. Closed April–May and for about 10 days each at Onam and Christmas; we book your place ahead.
👣 In the kalaris: Footwear comes off in the classrooms — wear sandals that slip on and off easily. Watch quietly; ask before photographing students.
🌊 By the river: The Nila is shallow most of the year but has sudden deep pools and soft sand. Walking only on the riverbank — no wading or bathing.
🎟️ Entry fees: Kalamandalam and Vazhani dam tickets are paid direct at the gate. Some classes may be off on a given day; the tour still covers the campus and gallery.
TCR_KALAMANDALAM.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
TCR_KALAMANDALAM.exc: Lunch; Kalamandalam and dam entry; Tolls and parking (private trips)
TCR_KALAMANDALAM.carry: Slip-on sandals; Hat and sunscreen; Reusable water bottle; Cash for entry fees

TCR_COK.desc: Flying out of Cochin International? We pick you up at your door anywhere in Thrissur and drop you at the right terminal — or meet you at arrivals and bring you home.
TCR_COK.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Thrissur town, Ollur, Puzhakkal, Irinjalakuda or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~55 km on NH 544: About 1.5 hours via Mannuthy, Paliyekkara, Chalakudy and Angamaly — longer at peak hours.
Drop-off — Cochin International Airport: Domestic (T1) or international (T3) departures. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
TCR_COK.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 4.5 hours before an international flight and 3.5 hours before a domestic one. Chalakudy and Angamaly towns jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛫 Which terminal?: Domestic flights use T1; international flights use T3. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags. Families with large bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller.
🔁 Landing in Kochi?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
TCR_COK.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
TCR_COK.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal (T1 / T3) noted; Water for the drive

TCR_CCJ.desc: Flying from Calicut International at Karipur? We pick you up at your door in Thrissur, Kunnamkulam or Guruvayur and drop you at the right terminal — or meet you at arrivals.
TCR_CCJ.itin:
Pickup — Your door: Home or hotel in Thrissur, Kunnamkulam, Guruvayur or nearby — at the time we agree for your flight.
On the road — ~110 km via Kuttippuram: About 2.5–3 hours via Kunnamkulam, Edappal, Kuttippuram, Valanchery and Kottakkal on NH 66.
Drop-off — Calicut International Airport: Domestic or international departures at Karipur. Reverse trips start from the arrivals exit. (No waiting charges on arrivals)
TCR_CCJ.gtk:
✈️ Timing your trip: Leave about 6 hours before an international flight and 5 hours before a domestic one. Kunnamkulam, Edappal and Kottakkal towns jam at peak hours — we plan around them.
🛫 Which terminal?: Karipur has separate domestic and international terminals on one campus. Check your ticket and tell us — we drop you at the right kerb.
🧳 Luggage: Gulf flights mean big bags: choose an MPV, Premium SUV or Traveller for families. Hatchbacks and sedans suit 2–3 people with check-in bags.
🔁 Landing at Karipur?: Share your flight number; we track delays and meet you at the arrivals exit with a name board. We track your flight — no waiting charges if it lands late.
TCR_CCJ.inc: Door-to-door pickup; No waiting charges on arrivals; Driver bata; Fuel and per-km charges
TCR_CCJ.exc: Tolls and airport parking; Meals on the way
TCR_CCJ.carry: Passport / ID and tickets; Flight number shared with us; Terminal noted; Water for the drive

TCR_VALPARAI.desc: Past Athirappilly falls and through 55 km of rainforest to the Tamil Nadu border at Malakkappara, a night in Valparai's tea hills, then down the 40 hairpins to Aliyar.
TCR_VALPARAI.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive: From your door, hotel, Thrissur station or bus stand; breakfast at Chalakudy.
Day 1 · 8:15 AM — Athirappilly & the forest road: A viewpoint stop at Athirappilly Falls, then through the Vazhachal and Sholayar forests to Malakkappara. (Road open 6 AM–6 PM only)
Day 1 · afternoon — Valparai & Nallamudi viewpoint: Lunch and check-in, then a walk through tea to the Nallamudi cliff-top view. Overnight in Valparai. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · 8:00 AM — Puthuthottam rainforest: Rainforest where lion-tailed macaques are often seen by the road. (Watch from the vehicle side)
Day 2 · morning — 40 hairpins to Aliyar: Loam's viewpoint on the way down, then the Aliyar dam and park. (Monkey Falls if open)
Day 2 · ~6:00 PM — Drive home: Lunch at Pollachi, then via Palakkad to your door in Thrissur.
TCR_VALPARAI.gtk:
🌳 Forest road: The Athirappilly–Malakkappara road is open to vehicles only from 6 AM to 6 PM, with check posts at both ends. No getting out inside the forest; elephants use this road and stops are monitored.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Interstate permit and border tax are billed at actual cost. Tamil Nadu has ordered an e-pass for Valparai — we apply if needed and re-check before you go.
🌀 Down via Aliyar: Day 2 descends the Aliyar ghat — about 40 hairpin bends, taken slowly with brake-cooling stops. Carry motion sickness tablets if bends bother you.
🚯 No plastic: Disposable plastic is banned on the forest roads and in Valparai; bags may be checked. Bring a refillable bottle; keep snacks in boxes.
TCR_VALPARAI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; Athirappilly–Valparai sightseeing; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
TCR_VALPARAI.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry fees and any e-pass charge; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
TCR_VALPARAI.carry: Photo ID; Light jacket; Motion sickness tablets; Refillable water bottle

TCR_MUNNAR.desc: Waterfalls on the climb, tea estates as far as you can see and the Nilgiri tahr of Eravikulam — Kerala's favourite hill station, about five hours from Thrissur.
TCR_MUNNAR.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive up: From your door, hotel, Thrissur station, the bus stand or Cochin Airport; about 160 km via Angamaly, Perumbavoor and Kothamangalam, roughly 5 hours.
Day 1 · 9:30 AM — Cheeyappara & Valara falls: Roadside waterfalls in the Neriamangalam forest — a short photo stop. (Fullest in the monsoon)
Day 1 · midday — Tea Museum: How tea goes from leaf to cup, at Nullatanni. Lunch in Munnar town. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 1 · afternoon — Mattupetty Dam & Echo Point: Lake views and optional boating on the Top Station road. Overnight in Munnar. (Stay booked by you)
Day 2 · morning — Eravikulam National Park: Park buses take you up Rajamala to see the Nilgiri tahr. (Tickets online · closed ~Feb–Mar)
Day 2 · ~6:30 PM — Drive home: Leave after lunch; back at your door in Thrissur by evening.
TCR_MUNNAR.gtk:
🐐 Eravikulam: Tickets are sold online in time slots — book a few days ahead; we can help. Closed for the tahr calving season, usually February–March; then we go to Top Station instead.
🍃 Tea & spices: Tea estates are private land — photograph from the roadside. Spice gardens at Pallivasal and Kallar are optional, paid direct.
🏨 Your stay: You book your hotel; Munnar town, Pothamedu and Chithirapuram are popular. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
🧥 Weather & roads: Cool mornings, cold in December–January — bring a layer. In heavy-rain alerts hill roads can close at night — we plan to be off the ghat before dark.
TCR_MUNNAR.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 2 days; All Munnar sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowance; No waiting charges
TCR_MUNNAR.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Park, museum and boating fees; Tolls and parking
TCR_MUNNAR.carry: Warm jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash for entry fees

TCR_NELLIYAMPATHY.desc: Your own vehicle for a cool day in the hills: Pothundy dam, ten hairpins through the forest, then orange farms, tea estates and cliff-top views at Seethargundu — two hours from Thrissur.
TCR_NELLIYAMPATHY.itin:
6:30 AM — Pickup: From your door, hotel, Thrissur station or the bus stand; via the Kuthiran tunnel and Vadakkanchery, breakfast on the way.
8:45 AM — Pothundy dam: A quick stop at the old earth dam at the foot of the hills, by the forest check post. (Photos only)
9:15 AM — Up the ten hairpins: A 17 km forest climb to Kaikatty, with stops at safe viewpoints. (Forest check post on the way)
10:15 AM — Seethargundu viewpoint: Cliff-top views over the Kollengode plains and a seasonal waterfall. (Short walk)
11:45 AM — Orange farm & Kesavanpara: The government orange farm, tea and cardamom estates and the Kesavanpara rock view. Lunch in the hills, own expense.
6:30 PM — Drop-off: Down the ghat by mid-afternoon; back to your door in Thrissur.
TCR_NELLIYAMPATHY.gtk:
🛣️ Hairpin road: About 10 hairpins between Pothundy and Kaikatty — carry motion sickness tablets if needed. Vehicles are logged at the forest check post; we go up early and come down before dark.
🌧️ Weather: Best from September to February; cool and misty most mornings. Heavy monsoon rain can bring landslips on the ghat — we re-check the day before.
🍽️ Food & cash: Few places to eat in the hills — we stop for a proper breakfast on the way up. No ATM or fuel up there: carry cash for entry and shops.
🐘 Wildlife: Elephants and gaur sometimes cross near the estates at dawn and dusk. Stay in the vehicle if animals are on the road; your driver will wait.
TCR_NELLIYAMPATHY.inc: Private vehicle and driver; All Nelliyampathy sightseeing drives; Driver bata; No waiting charges
TCR_NELLIYAMPATHY.exc: Meals; Entry, jeep safari and farm shop; Tolls and parking
TCR_NELLIYAMPATHY.carry: Light jacket; Walking shoes; Motion sickness tablets; Cash (no ATM up the hill)

TCR_WAYANAD.desc: Up the nine hairpins of the Thamarassery ghat to Kerala's green north: forest lakes, the country's largest earth dam and Edakkal's ancient carvings — your own vehicle and driver.
TCR_WAYANAD.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Wayanad: From your door in Thrissur — about 190 km via Kunnamkulam, Kuttippuram, Kozhikode and the Thamarassery ghat, roughly 6 hours with breaks. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · midday — Lakkidi viewpoint & Pookode Lake: The view back down the ghat, then a forest lake right on the way in. (Boating optional, paid direct)
Day 2 · morning — Edakkal Caves: A short, steep climb to caves with prehistoric rock carvings. (Closed Mondays · entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Banasura Sagar Dam: India's largest earth dam, with green islands in the reservoir. (Entry & boating own expense)
Day 2 · or swap in — Chembra, Soochipara or Kuruva: A peak trek, a forest waterfall or bamboo-raft river islands — pick one. (Seasonal · we check if open)
Day 3 — Drive home: Leave after breakfast; back at your door in Thrissur by mid-afternoon.
TCR_WAYANAD.gtk:
🪨 Edakkal Caves: Closed on Mondays — we plan around it. The climb is steep: not ideal for elders or small children.
🌧️ Seasonal spots: Kuruva Island closes in the monsoon and has a daily visitor cap; treks and falls can shut after heavy rain. We check on the day and swap stops.
🏨 Your stay: You book your resort or homestay; Kalpetta and Vythiri are central. Your driver's night allowance is in our price.
⛰️ The ghat: Thamarassery ghat jams on weekends and holidays. We start early both ways to beat the queues.
TCR_WAYANAD.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; All Wayanad sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
TCR_WAYANAD.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, boating and trek fees; Tolls and parking
TCR_WAYANAD.carry: Trekking shoes; Raincoat; Light jacket; Cash for entry fees

TCR_OOTY.desc: The Nilgiris' classic hill stations: gardens, a lake and the highest peak in Ooty, tea country in Coonoor, and the famous toy train — your vehicle, your pace.
TCR_OOTY.itin:
Day 1 · 6:30 AM — Pickup & drive to Ooty: From your door in Thrissur — about 210 km via Palakkad, Coimbatore, Mettupalayam and the Coonoor ghat, roughly 6–7 hours. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · evening — Ooty Lake: An easy first evening: a walk or a boat on the lake. (Boating optional, paid direct)
Day 2 · morning — Botanical Garden & Doddabetta: Ooty's 1840s gardens, then the highest point in the Nilgiris. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Coonoor — Sim's Park & Dolphin's Nose: Tea country, a hillside garden and a famous valley lookout.
Day 2 · optional — Nilgiri Mountain Railway: Ride the UNESCO-listed toy train between Ooty and Coonoor; we meet you at the other end. (Tickets in advance · paid direct)
Day 3 — Drive home: Leave after breakfast; back at your door in Thrissur by late afternoon.
TCR_OOTY.gtk:
🎫 Nilgiris e-pass: Every vehicle entering the Nilgiris needs a Tamil Nadu e-pass — we apply for it. Single-use plastic is banned: carry refillable steel bottles.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Ooty is in Tamil Nadu: interstate permit, border tax and green fee are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🚂 Toy train: Seats sell out — book on IRCTC well before your trip. Timings change; we confirm them with you.
🧥 Weather: Cold nights all year — bring warm clothes. The ghat has many hairpins; carry motion sickness tablets.
TCR_OOTY.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; Ooty and Coonoor sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
TCR_OOTY.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry, boating and toy train tickets; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
TCR_OOTY.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Refillable water bottle; Cash for entry fees

TCR_KODAIKANAL.desc: A star-shaped lake, cliff-edge walks and pillar rocks in the Palani hills — up the ghat from Palani to Tamil Nadu's cool retreat, with your own vehicle and driver.
TCR_KODAIKANAL.itin:
Day 1 · 6:00 AM — Pickup & drive to Kodaikanal: From your door in Thrissur — about 235 km via Palakkad, Pollachi, Palani and the Kodai ghat, roughly 7–8 hours. (Stay booked by you)
Day 1 · evening — Kodai Lake: A walk, a cycle or a boat round the star-shaped lake. (Boating paid direct)
Day 2 · morning — Coaker's Walk & Bryant Park: A cliff-edge path with views to the plains, then the gardens. (Entry own expense)
Day 2 · afternoon — Pillar Rocks, pine forest & Guna Caves viewpoint: Granite pillars, tall pines and the famous caves lookout. (Entry own expense)
Day 3 — Drive home: Leave after breakfast; back at your door in Thrissur by evening.
TCR_KODAIKANAL.gtk:
🎫 Kodaikanal e-pass: Tourist vehicles need a Tamil Nadu e-pass for Kodaikanal — we apply for it. Plastic is restricted: carry refillable bottles.
🪪 Tamil Nadu entry: Interstate permit, border tax and green fee are billed at actual cost. We re-check entry rules before you travel.
🌫️ Viewpoints: Mist can hide Pillar Rocks and Coaker's Walk — mornings are usually clearer. We reorder stops for the best views.
🧥 Weather: Cool all year, cold at night — bring warm layers. The ghat is winding: carry motion sickness tablets.
TCR_KODAIKANAL.inc: Private vehicle and driver for 3 days; Kodaikanal sightseeing drives; Driver bata and night allowances; No waiting charges
TCR_KODAIKANAL.exc: Your hotel; Meals; Entry and boating fees; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals
TCR_KODAIKANAL.carry: Warm jacket; Photo ID; Walking shoes; Cash for entry fees

TCR_VELANKANNI.desc: Through the Palakkad Gap and across the Kaveri delta to the Basilica of Our Lady of Good Health — Mass, Our Lady's Tank, candle prayers and a full, unhurried day at the shrine by the sea.
TCR_VELANKANNI.itin:
Day 1 · 5:00 AM — Pickup: Thrissur railway station · Thrissur KSRTC bus station · Swaraj Round (≈470 km via Coimbatore & Trichy)
Day 1 · evening — Evening prayer: Reach Velankanni by about 4:30 PM; candles and prayer at the Shrine Basilica. (Room booked by you)
Day 2 · 9:00 AM — Mass & Our Lady's Tank: Malayalam Mass at the Morning Star Church, then Our Lady's Tank and the Way of the Cross. (Times re-confirmed)
Day 2 · late morning — Museum & Old Church: The museum of offerings and the Old Church by Our Lady's Tank. Lunch near the shrine (own expense).
Day 2 · evening — Beach & candle prayers: A walk on Velankanni beach, then the evening rosary and candles at the basilica. (No sea bathing)
Day 3 · ≈4:30 PM — Drop-off: Thrissur station, KSRTC bus station, Swaraj Round, or your own stop in the city (Leaves Velankanni 5:30 AM)
TCR_VELANKANNI.gtk:
⛪ At the shrine: Shoulders and knees covered; follow the volunteers in the queues and keep silence in the chapels. Masses run daily in Tamil, English and other languages — we re-confirm the Malayalam Mass time before you travel.
🌊 Beach & crowds: No sea bathing — the sea is rough and drownings are reported. We fix one meeting point at the main arch; children stay with an adult.
🏨 Your room: You book your own room near the shrine — we share a list of pilgrim lodges. Driver bata and night allowance are in our price.
🛣️ Long road & border: About 470 km each way on highways, with breaks every 2–3 hours. Tamil Nadu permit and border tax at actual cost; carry a photo ID.
TCR_VELANKANNI.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Driver bata and night allowance; Caretaker for 10+ guests
TCR_VELANKANNI.exc: Your room; Meals; Offerings and museum entry; Permits, border tax, tolls, parking — at actuals

TCR_NALAMBALAM.desc: Rama, Bharata, Lakshmana and Shatrughna in one sacred morning — Thriprayar, Koodalmanikyam, Moozhikkulam and Payammal, in the traditional order and before the noon closing.
TCR_NALAMBALAM.itin:
5:00 AM — Pickup: Thrissur railway station · Thrissur KSRTC bus station · Swaraj Round (Early start · see below)
5:45 AM — Thriprayar Sree Rama Temple: Rama on the river bank; devotees feed the temple fish (meenoottu). (Dress code · see below)
7:00 AM — Koodalmanikyam, Irinjalakuda: One of India's rare temples to Bharata, by a huge tank. Breakfast in town, own expense. (Hindus only inside)
9:00 AM — Moozhikkulam Lakshmana Temple: Lakshmana Perumal by the Chalakudy river — one of Kerala's 13 Divya Desams. (Closes late morning)
10:30 AM — Payammal Shatrughna Temple: The smallest of the four. Lunch in Irinjalakuda after, own expense. (Last of the four)
1:30 PM — Drop-off: Thrissur station, KSRTC bus station, Swaraj Round, or your own stop in the city
TCR_NALAMBALAM.gtk:
🛕 Temple rules: Kerala temples usually admit only Hindus inside; other guests see the gateways, ponds and grounds from outside. Men: shirts off, mundu or dhoti; women: saree, churidar or long skirt. Footwear stays in the vehicle.
🙏 The four temples: Nalambalam means the temples of the four brothers. Tradition is to see all four in this order on the same morning. Queues can be long on busy days — we confirm temple timings the evening before.
🐟 Offerings: Popular offerings: meenoottu (feeding the fish) at Thriprayar, the lotus garland at Koodalmanikyam, Sudarshana pushpanjali at Payammal. Paid at the temple counters, own expense; keep small cash.
🚉 Pickup points: Thrissur station first, then the KSRTC bus station, then Swaraj Round — we share exact times the evening before. A 5 AM start: carry breakfast money; we stop in Irinjalakuda.
TCR_NALAMBALAM.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
TCR_NALAMBALAM.exc: Breakfast and lunch; Offerings and poojas; Tolls and parking (private trips)
TCR_NALAMBALAM.carry: Temple dress (mundu / saree / churidar); Easy slip-on footwear; Cash for offerings; Water bottle

TCR_PULLU.desc: Thrissur's green side by evening: the kole paddy fields and lotus ponds of Pullu, a coracle ride on the canal, then sunset at Snehatheeram beach and a coastal fish dinner.
TCR_PULLU.itin:
2:30 PM — Pickup: Thrissur railway station · Thrissur KSRTC bus station · Swaraj Round
3:15 PM — Pullu kole fields: Paddy fields along the Perumbuzha canal, lotus ponds, and duck herders with their flocks. (Free to walk)
4:00 PM — Coracle ride at Pullu: A 20-minute round-boat ride on the canal with a local boatman. (Paid direct)
5:15 PM — Snehatheeram beach: Thalikulam's beach park: a walk on the sand and sunset over the Arabian Sea. (Park entry own expense)
7:00 PM — Coastal dinner: Fish curry meals and fry near Thalikulam, own expense — veg too. (Own expense)
8:30 PM — Drop-off: Thrissur station, KSRTC bus station, Swaraj Round, or your own stop in the city
TCR_PULLU.gtk:
🛶 Coracle ride: Round boats run by local boatmen at Pullu: about 20 minutes, up to four guests a boat, paid direct. We ask for life jackets for everyone; in heavy rain or high water we skip the ride and walk the fields.
🏖️ At the beach: The sea here is not for swimming — paddling at the edge only, where lifeguards allow. The beach park has a small entry fee, paid direct; keep children close.
🌅 Sunset: Sunset time moves through the year, between about 6:10 and 6:50 PM — we time the beach stop so you catch it. Fields and ponds look different month to month; ducks and lotus are not guaranteed every day.
🚉 Pickup points: Thrissur station first, then the KSRTC bus station, then Swaraj Round — we share exact times the evening before. Drop-off back in the same order, or at your own stop in the city.
TCR_PULLU.inc: Shared seat, solo to 15; Water & snacks; Free drop within the city; Caretaker for 10+ guests
TCR_PULLU.exc: Coracle ride and beach entry; Dinner; Tolls and parking (private trips)
TCR_PULLU.carry: Hat and sunscreen; Mosquito repellent; Towel or spare clothes; Cash for ride and dinner

TCR_EV_BUONNATALE.desc: Thrissur's Christmas carnival: thousands of Santas, angels, floats and flash mobs march from St Thomas College round the Swaraj Round. Your own vehicle, a driver who waits, a ride home. Event dates: ≈Sun 27 Dec 2026 · from 5 PM (Estimate — confirm with the Thrissur Archdiocese).
TCR_EV_BUONNATALE.itin:
3:30 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, Thrissur station, KSRTC or Sakthan bus stand, or Cochin Airport.
4:15 PM — Drop near Swaraj Round: We drop as close as the police allow; find a spot on the Round before the crowd builds. (Walk the last stretch)
5:00 PM — The parade sets off: Santas and angels from over a hundred parishes leave St Thomas College. (Main event)
6:00 PM — Floats round the Round: Tableaux, bands, dancing and flash mobs circle the Round to Sakthan ground. (Very crowded)
8:15 PM — Pickup at the meeting point: Agreed with your driver at the drop; roads open slowly after the parade. (Expect slow traffic)
9:00 PM — Home: Back home, to your hotel or the station.
TCR_EV_BUONNATALE.gtk:
🎅 Buon Natale: A Christmas parade held since 2013 by the Thrissur Archdiocese with the city's people; it raises money for charity. It set a Guinness record in 2014 with 18,112 Santas; about 15,000 took part in 2024 and 2025.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: Buon Natale is held on 27 December — a Sunday in 2026 — with the parade from about 5 to 8 PM. The Archdiocese announces the programme — we re-confirm before your trip.
👨‍👩‍👧 With children: Pick a spot on the Round's edge early and keep children in front of you. Drones are banned on parade day; carry water, the evening is warm.
TCR_EV_BUONNATALE.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Thrissur or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
TCR_EV_BUONNATALE.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Food and stalls
TCR_EV_BUONNATALE.carry: Water bottle; Comfortable footwear; A Santa cap for the fun of it; Phone, charged, with our number saved

TCR_EV_POORAM.desc: The pooram of all poorams at Vadakkunnathan: panchavadyam, the Elanjithara melam and the kudamattam, as Thiruvambady and Paramekkavu face off with elephants and parasols. Event dates: ≈Sat 17 Apr 2027 · Thekkinkadu Maidan (Estimate — confirm with the Thiruvambady & Paramekkavu Devaswoms).
TCR_EV_POORAM.itin:
10:30 AM — Pickup: Home, hotel, Thrissur station, KSRTC or Sakthan bus stand, or Cochin Airport.
11:00 AM — Drop near Swaraj Round: As close as the police allow; the Round is closed to traffic. (Walk the last stretch)
11:30 AM — Madathil Varavu: Thiruvambady's panchavadyam at Naduvilal, to about 2:30. Lunch own expense. (Very crowded)
2:45 PM — Elanjithara melam: Paramekkavu's pandi melam in the Vadakkunnathan compound. (Main melam)
5:30 PM — Kudamattam: Both sides swap bright parasols on the elephants at the south gopuram. (Main event)
8:30 PM — Pickup & home: Meet your driver at the agreed point; home, hotel or station. (Expect slow traffic)
TCR_EV_POORAM.gtk:
🐘 The pooram: Held at the Vadakkunnathan temple's Thekkinkadu Maidan; Thiruvambady and Paramekkavu lead it, with smaller temples joining through the day. About fifteen elephants a side line up at the south gopuram for the kudamattam, the parasol exchange.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: Thrissur Pooram falls on the Pooram star of the month of Medam — we expect Saturday 17 April 2027. The Devaswoms announce the date — we re-confirm before your trip. The night fireworks are not part of this trip.
👀 Where to stand: Morning and kudamattam: the south gopuram side; melam: the Naduvilal side or the Elanjithara courtyard. Women can use the Pink Police point by the banyan tree at the south gate.
TCR_EV_POORAM.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Thrissur or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
TCR_EV_POORAM.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Exhibition tickets and offerings
TCR_EV_POORAM.carry: Cap, umbrella, water; Comfortable footwear; Ear plugs for children; Phone, charged, with our number saved

TCR_EV_PULIKALI.desc: Onam's painted tigers take over the Swaraj Round — teams of puli dancers swaying to the drums, with tableaux trucks. Your own vehicle, a driver who waits, a ride home. Event dates: ≈Wed 15 Sep 2027 · fourth day of Onam (Estimate — confirm with the Thrissur Corporation).
TCR_EV_PULIKALI.itin:
2:30 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, Thrissur station, KSRTC or Sakthan bus stand, or Cochin Airport.
3:00 PM — Drop near Swaraj Round: No private vehicles near the Round from 2 PM — we drop at the nearest open point. (Walk the last stretch)
4:00 PM — The tigers set off: Teams gather at Bini junction and are flagged off towards the Round. (Find a spot early)
Evening — Tigers round the Round: Team after team dances past Paramekkavu, MO Road and Naduvilal. (Main event)
9:30 PM — Finale & pickup: The last teams finish by about 10 PM; meet your driver at the agreed point. (Expect slow traffic)
10:30 PM — Home: Back home, to your hotel or the station.
TCR_EV_PULIKALI.gtk:
🐯 Pulikali: Men painted as tigers and leopards dance through the city on the fourth day of Onam — a folk art Thrissur has kept for generations. Teams from different desams compete, with prizes for the best tigers, tableaux and discipline.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: Pulikali is on Nalaam Onam, the fourth day of Onam — we expect Wednesday 15 September 2027. The Corporation fixes the date and the number of teams — we re-confirm before your trip.
👀 Watching: Good spots: near Paramekkavu, MO Road and Naduvilal, where the teams are judged. Keep children close; don't touch the painted dancers — the paint takes hours to put on.
TCR_EV_PULIKALI.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Thrissur or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
TCR_EV_PULIKALI.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Food and stalls
TCR_EV_PULIKALI.carry: Cap, umbrella, water; Comfortable footwear; Ear plugs for children; Phone, charged, with our number saved

TCR_EV_UTHRALIKAVU.desc: Wadakkanchery's great pooram: three villages bring caparisoned elephants and panchavadyam to the Kali temple in the paddy fields. Your own vehicle, a driver who waits, a ride home. Event dates: ≈Tue 23 Feb 2027 · Wadakkanchery (Estimate — confirm with the temple).
TCR_EV_UTHRALIKAVU.itin:
1:30 PM — Pickup: Home, hotel, Thrissur station, KSRTC or Sakthan bus stand, or Cochin Airport.
2:30 PM — Drop near Uthralikavu: About 25 km via Mulankunnathukavu and Wadakkanchery; walk the last stretch. (Walk the last stretch)
Afternoon — Desam processions: Enkakkad, Kumaranellur and Wadakkanchery arrive with elephants and drums. (Find a spot early)
Evening — Elephants in the fields: The three desams line up their tuskers before the temple. (Main moment)
9:00 PM — Pickup at the meeting point: Agreed with your driver at the drop; the night pooram and dawn fireworks are not included. (Expect slow traffic)
10:00 PM — Home: Back home, to your hotel or the station.
TCR_EV_UTHRALIKAVU.gtk:
🐘 The pooram: The Sree Ruthira Mahakalikavu temple sits in paddy fields 2 km north of Wadakkanchery, by the Shoranur road and the railway line. Three desams — Enkakkad, Kumaranellur and Wadakkanchery — each bring seven to eleven caparisoned elephants.
🚧 Roads & crowds: Police close roads around the venue on the main days. Your driver drops you at the nearest open point and you walk the last stretch. Agree a meeting point and time with the driver before you get out — phone networks jam in big crowds.
📅 Date: The pooram is on the second Tuesday of the Malayalam month of Kumbham — we expect Tuesday 23 February 2027. The temple fixes the programme — we re-confirm before your trip.
🎆 Elephants & fireworks: Keep well back from the elephants and never walk behind them. Fireworks need a fresh licence every year and may not be allowed — we don't promise them.
TCR_EV_UTHRALIKAVU.inc: Private vehicle and driver for the day; Door-to-door, in Thrissur or from your city; Driver waits through the event — no waiting charge; Driver bata (+ night allowance on late or 2-day trips)
TCR_EV_UTHRALIKAVU.exc: Food and stay; Tolls and parking; Offerings
TCR_EV_UTHRALIKAVU.carry: Cap and water bottle; Comfortable footwear; Ear plugs for children; Phone, charged, with our number saved
